needle.js and needle.wasm in this folder are the WebAssembly build of the Cactus needle engine,
by Cactus Compute, Inc., copied with an appended ESM export in needle.js (WASM unmodified) from the wasm/ folder of
https://huggingface.co/Cactus-Compute/needle3 (revision 3391a1007e7db31d2fe5c69c734bbe93a9c1ce79).
Source: https://github.com/cactus-compute/needle

Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (see LICENSE.txt in this folder).

The Shruti model weights that this engine runs are built on Cactus Whistle (Cactus Compute, Apache-2.0)
and released by Udgam Labs under Apache-2.0: https://huggingface.co/udgamlabs/Shruti
